description: Least-privilege surface for the tray popover (stache-popover). It can listen for host events and call host_status, hide_popover, the Overview's module and window commands (set_module_enabled, module_session_action, retry_module, open_accessibility_guide), the settings editor's config_files, config_document, config_edit and open_config_file, and the three Accessibility commands (request_accessibility, open_accessibility_settings, quit_app). No close, drag, filesystem, shell, opener, dialog, HTTP or plugin permissions are granted.
